key_insight: For deep linear neural networks with regularized squared loss, SGD iterates remain almost surely bounded and converge almost surely to the set of critical points under mild conditions.
engineering_relevance: The results strengthen the theoretical foundation for stochastic training in a tractable non-convex model, covering both deterministic and adaptive step-size choices.
method: Extend gradient-descent convergence analysis to SGD.
Establish almost sure boundedness of SGD iterates.
Use asymptotic pseudotrajectories to prove convergence without relying on Lipschitz properties or whitened data.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical convergence guarantees, not dataset benchmarks or empirical evaluations.
watch_item: The guarantees concern deep linear networks and convergence to critical points, not necessarily global minima or nonlinear-network training.
paper_title: Convergence of stochastic gradient descent for learning linear neural networks
